title: review
description: A review of another profile, at the path `review/<id>` in the reviewer's own profile. Only who it is about is required: a review can be as thin as pointing at a person. What is missing weighs less; nothing is refused. Its market is the market of the profile it is about, and that market may add fields.

subject.description: The reviewed profile's name: its address.

score.description: From "1" to "10", with at most one decimal ("8.5"): decimal text, since a record holds no fractional numbers.

offer.description: Optional. The offer this review is about: its <id> in offer/<id>, in the subject's folder.

evidence.description: Optional. What shows the deal took place on chain, in base58: the address of its escrow receipt, or the signature of a direct payment between the two profiles' pay addresses. An index weighs a review without evidence it can check near zero.

media.description: Optional. Photos and short videos of the work.
A photo or a short video, named by the SHA-256 of its bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lowercase hex.

mimeType.description: The file's media type, type/subtype in lower case, such as image/jpeg. Which types to take is each host's own choice, and each reader's.

size.description: Bytes. How large a blob to take is each host's own choice, and each reader's.
